messages:
julie-sales: Heads up — live demo with FinOps POC in us-west-2 is seeing intermittent 5xxs, customer lost responses twice in the last 8 minutes. Anyone free to swarm?

maria-support: On it. Julie can you paste a sample request_id + approximate timestamps and the route/model used?

julie-sales: request_id=rcq-8a7b, timestamps ~1776100003 and 1776100019, model=rwd-13b-q4, happened ~3x in last 10m during burst of short prompts. Customer on call: @finops-team (I told them we were investigating).

ajay-runtime: rwd-13b-q4 is memory-heavy when batching. Autoscaler will spawn new GPU pods but there's a ~30–45s cold start for weights. If the workload bursts faster than warmup, you can see capacity_exhausted -> 503. Check if route has a fallback to a smaller model (rwd-7b) or a burst_pool enabled.

samir-oncall: I pulled the inference-srv logs for that window, here are the tail lines:

```
[2026-03-12T15:13:23Z] request=rcq-8a7b peer=ingress-1 route=/gen model=rwd-13b-q4 error=capacity_exhausted status=503 queue_len=48
[2026-03-12T15:13:24Z] autoscaler: scale_up triggered target_replicas=3 current=1 cooldown=45s
[2026-03-12T15:13:24Z] request=rcq-9f2c peer=ingress-2 route=/gen model=rwd-13b-q4 error=capacity_exhausted status=503 queue_len=52
```

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-87 (https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-87) :rotating_light:

maria-support: Short-term remediation options: 1) enable model fallback to rwd-7b on this route, 2) reduce max_batch_size to 32 or lower, 3) enable burst_pool/burst_capacity for the project if allowed. Julie, I can patch the route or you can flip fallback from Console.

julie-sales: I can flip fallback and lower batch size now. Will also route demo traffic to eu-west as a temporary backup.

julie-sales: Done — fallback=rwd-7b enabled, max_batch_size=32 set on route, traffic partially routed to eu-west.

samir-oncall: Watching metrics — error rate dropped to zero over the last 2m after fallback. No new 5xxs observed in logs.

ajay-runtime: For follow-ups: reduce autoscale_cooldown to 15s for this POC, set min_replicas=1 for faster baseline, and increase request_queue_size to 200 to prevent immediate rejections. I'll open a config PR for the POC project.

maria-support: Note on cost/impact: falling back to rwd-7b reduces token cost (~40%) but adds ~70–150ms latency. Julie, confirm with customer whether they accept the latency trade-off.

julie-sales: Customer OK with slight latency increase for demo stability. They asked for a follow-up to evaluate Dedicated/reserved capacity for predictable throughput.

maria-support: Created support ticket SUP-6721 for Dedicated evaluation + perf tuning, assigned to ajay-runtime. Also adding notes to INC-2026-87.

samir-oncall: All clear — 0 errors in last 10m, metrics stable. Closing incident after postmortem doc. :thumbsup:

maria-support: Thanks everyone. Follow-up action items in SUP-6721. If anything else pops up, re-open this thread or ping oncall.
